---
title: "Cloud & Big Data Analytics: Job Postings Research"
---

Welcome to our research website for the Cloud and Big Data Analytics class.

This project analyzes approximately 800,000 job postings from the year 2026. We apply a standard Data Science and Machine Learning lifecycle to understand industry trends, classify job roles, and extract key insights from the dataset.

## Project Structure

1. **[Data Exploration](01_data_exploration.qmd)**: Initial data loading, cleaning, and exploratory data analysis (EDA).
2. **[Modeling](02_modeling.qmd)**: Machine learning models for industry classification.
